## GHL 3. Reminder Tags

**In simple words:** every hour, n8n looks at the Square calendar. When it's time for a reminder, it fills in the appointment details on the GoHighLevel contact and adds a tag:
- **sq-remind-48h** (2 days before)
- **sq-remind-2h** (2 hours before)
- **sq-completed** (after the visit)

GoHighLevel workflows send the actual texts. Square is always the truth, so moved bookings get the right reminder.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ locationId: $('Config').first().json.ghlLocationId, phone: $('Contact Details').item.json.phone, firstName: $('Contact Details').item.json.firstName || undefined, lastName: $('Contact Details').item.json.lastName || undefined, customFields: Object.entries($('Contact Details').item.json.fields || {}).map(([key, field_value]) => ({ key, field_value: String(field_value) })) }) }}
